reference_prefix_evidence.semantics: No original cycle exit at this microsecond; missing old ordinal does not change exact denominator. Releases excluded from ordinary cycle ratio.

definitions.prefix_filter: Read only up to the captured checkpoint byte bound. Stop material event inclusion after T. Future CANCEL_ACK_SCHEDULED timestamps do not terminate the scan because these are scheduled notifications, not future executed fills.
definitions.physical_prefix_hash: Hash of original complete JSONL rows preceding the first post-T SUBMIT/FILL/QUEUE_FLOW/SETTLEMENT/RELEASE_SIGNAL. Rows with explicit future timestamps are excluded from reconstructed state even when physically recorded earlier as schedules.
definitions.net_realized_pnl: Sum of ordinary and release settlement net PnL. Reserve transfers are internal and not extra profit. Unsold inventory basis is not realized loss.
definitions.fees: Zero under this frozen conditional profile; not evidence of exact account-specific historical Binance commission.
definitions.closed_utc_days: Jan 1 through Feb 28 inclusive. A day is active when at least one ordinary full cycle settled; March 1 is excluded because T falls within it.
definitions.holding: First executed BUY fill to settlement. An unsettled position would be censored at T. Lock >24h sums only duration beyond 24h for each position.
definitions.order_categories: Mutually exclusive cumulative fill status at T for every submitted order. Full means filled quantity equals ordered quantity; partial_only means strictly between zero and full; no_fill includes zero-fill canceled/rejected/pending orders. SELL includes aggressive release orders. These are not counts of historical price-path opportunities.
definitions.partial_only: Does not assert that fully filled orders never experienced intermediate partial fills.
definitions.release_denominators: Executed-lot basis and original signal operating-bank basis are reported separately; both greater-than-10bps counts are zero at this T.

limitations: This reconstructs the old observation from a newer durable audit bound; it does not invent or reuse a historical checkpoint at T.
This is independent financial reconstruction, not a new full raw-trade support audit or historical L2 proof.
